description: Return the value of attribute `name` on the element identified by ref or selector (null when the attribute is absent — that is not an error). Returns: { ok, session_id, value }. Errors: REF_NOT_FOUND / SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (carries similar_refs), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_get_attribute
title: Get an element attribute
